title: Create a Custom GPT

body.text: your own pre-configured version of ChatGPT
— add instructions, knowledge files, and turn tools on/off. Build it through the GPT Builder, no coding needed.

example: "Create a GPT named 'Coffee Shop Assistant' that knows the whole menu from the uploaded file and answers customers in polite Thai"

title: Elements of a good GPT

body.text: clear instructions + up-to-date knowledge + example questions (conversation starters)
— and test it on many real cases before sharing it with others.

example: "Conversation starters: 'Recommend best-sellers' / 'This month's promotions' / 'How to pre-order'"
